decision.name: ACCEPT_TEST_ONLY_ORPHAN_FAIL_CLOSED_PROOF_HOLD_ARCHIVE_READER_INTEGRATION
decision.new_finding: New committed test asserts child exitcode 17, persistent .jsonl.lock, and subsequent ArchiveWriterLock timeout. This proves fail-closed behavior in bounded executor, NOT automatic crash recovery. storage.append_observations holds lock across read/dedup/append/fsync, but runner.run_once calls load_observations outside the lock, so the runner's archive reader is not serialized with another writer; a partial JSONL body can cause ValueError. This is a source-derived concurrency exposure, not an executed production failure. The known external consumer reads one atomic handoff JSON, so the pinned three-output generation mismatch remains diagnostic.
decision.runnable_no_network_test_contract: At this exact SHA, in a temp local_dir seed one valid observation. Spawn writer A with top-level target and a test-only wrapper around destination Path.open('a') that writes and flushes HALF the next JSON body, signals A_PARTIAL, waits RELEASE_A (bounded), then writes remainder+newline. Parent waits A_PARTIAL; with A still holding ArchiveWriterLock, assert load_observations raises ValueError for the deliberately incomplete row and runner.run_once(network=False, local_dir=tmp_path) also raises ValueError (its reader is outside lock). Release A in finally; bounded join and exitcode==0; assert complete JSONL is parseable, two unique rows, no lockfile. Include positive control where a COMPLETE JSON body without final newline is parseable (do not use newline absence as corruption oracle). This characterizes current behavior, not a passed reader-safety requirement; a stronger acceptance gate would require reader to see only complete rows or defer safely. Keep separate pinned two-writer generation diagnostic.
decision.reason_no_queue: Gemini structured JSON reliability unverified; C just changed public HEAD; A does not edit Specialist code or dispatch repeat failed tasks.

execution_blocker.next_feasible_recovery: Supervisor arrange isolated exact-SHA checkout or independent GitHub test runner for targeted/full pytest and controlled reader/write test; obtain fresh B/C verdicts at cd28731; document safe manual orphan-lock recovery policy before claiming operational resilience.
